title: ⌜𝑳
headline: Smart detection, Real-time monitoring, live video analysis smarter, faster and more reliable and analysis with saved history access.
btn_section_content: This project demonstrates an intelligent real-time multi-classification detection system that identifies multiple objects simultaneously with high accuracy. It brings together computer vision and deep learning to make live video analysis smarter, faster, and more reliable.

card.title: ⏰ Real-time Monitoring
card.content: Live Vision continuously processes camera feed in real-time to detect and identify objects instantly. The system ensures smooth video streaming with minimal delay, enabling accurate surveillance and monitoring of environments such as rooms, streets, or workplaces.

card.title: 💾 Saved Sessions
card.content: All detection sessions are automatically stored for future reference. Users can replay previous video streams, review detected objects frame-by-frame, and analyze specific events. This helps in tracking incidents, training improvements, and long-term monitoring insights.

card.title: 📊 Insights
card.content: Live Vision generates intelligent analytics from detection data, including object frequency, movement patterns, and detection trends over time. These insights help users understand behavioral patterns, improve decision-making, and enhance security efficiency.

footer_p1: An AI-powered platform for real-time monitoring, analysis and safety | Login is required to access LiveVision dashboards and analytics.
